scope: Read-only source/configuration audit plus explicit compiler and browser-discovery baseline. No browser launch, dependency modification, application build or repository edit performed.

findings.observation: Node profile overrides shared Preserve/Bundler/noEmit policy with composite NodeNext/declaration emission. Root manifest has no type:module. Include list omits script .mts files, most Playwright/Vitest configs and app Vite configs. Existing script .ts imports source outside a composite include set.
findings.proposedDisposition: Use explicit noEmit tools configuration matching the actual native-TypeScript/Vite tool path; include supported root/app configs and scripts, keep browser Storybook preview managed by existing story configs, and verify effective file coverage. Do not change root package module classification solely to suppress diagnostics.

findings.observation: Runtime unit config supplies #test-utils alias but compiler config has no corresponding paths mapping. Type include covers all tests .ts/.tsx except tests/store, mixing browser/component fixtures into unit profile.
findings.proposedDisposition: Add exact alias and give Vitest profile intentional unit/accessibility/smoke inputs. Keep Node catalog/handoff tests under tsconfig.store and browser tests under browser profile; do not weaken strictness/exact optional checks.
findings.actualDiagnostics: 27 diagnostics: missing #test-utils and root themes aliases, invalid JSX thrower inference, invalid private enum test fixtures, ES2023 toReversed against ES2022 profile, exact optional tuple indexing, unsupported Testing Library getByRole exact option, dataset bracket access. Preserve intentional invalid-input test coverage while typing its boundary honestly.

findings.observation: Browser typecheck omits docs/playground suites, default/component Playwright configs and standalone consumer. Prior #49/#50/#53 used temporary successful config extensions instead of durable profiles. Default config process.env.CI dot access conflicts with noPropertyAccessFromIndexSignature.
findings.proposedDisposition: Expand one documented browser compiler profile (or exact focused component companion) to include all maintained suites/configs/fixtures, change environment bracket access, and retain four independently discoverable runner configurations.

findings.observation: Three existence-only tests pass with stale dist files; root build only creates website output and smoke requires docs/playground too. No named smoke command builds all prerequisites.
findings.proposedDisposition: Make smoke runner itself prepare fresh outputs sequentially with checked exit statuses, or require a checked freshness receipt from existing ordered task commands. Add meaningful HTML/asset/reference assertions and negative stale/missing/output probes. Avoid an optional skip-build path and avoid creating a second general test orchestrator.

findings.observation: Only fast site/catalog/domain types are selected by typecheck; wider compiler/story/accessibility/smoke/profile discovery and component consumer are not named root commands or Taskfile entries. Store qualification exists but is not exposed in Taskfile.
findings.proposedDisposition: Retain fast command; add explicit tooling/unit/browser/workspace/story profiles and a composition command, named smoke/accessibility/component contracts, four-config discovery, final qualification Taskfile wrappers using store-environment.mjs. Reuse existing qualify-store sequential reporting rather than creating another runner.

findings.observation: Vitest accessibility scope is four semantic rendering tests, not an audit. Existing browser suites already implement extensive full-shell keyboard, contrast, reduced motion, forced colors, reflow and gallery interaction checks. Component provider test reloads iframe; same-document story-switching acceptance remains.
findings.proposedDisposition: Name semantic versus computed-browser scope truthfully and include existing shell/playground/component journeys in permanent profiles. Keep actual Chromium/manual/native zoom/screenreader review under #37/#70; do not duplicate already-authored checks.

findings.observation: Prior #53 receipt reports sitemap collision during concurrent website/Storybook builds. Static inspection shows root Storybook config has no website output path; website output and Storybook output are disjoint. Catalog tests use temporary directories. No cause established by source inspection. Two concurrent same-target website builds can race because normal build empties a shared output and writes routes later.
findings.proposedDisposition: Use sequential supported aggregate build commands and prove fresh outputs. Reproduce same-target build concurrency separately before proposing locking; do not claim Storybook was the cause or sequential commands repaired the historical failure.

findings.observation: Current aggregate qualifier exits nonzero on three known size ceilings and stops overall qualify-store before browsers. Per-document reachability exists as diagnostic evidence.
findings.proposedDisposition: Keep measured failure explicit. Separate storage/per-document/actual-browser semantics for owner review; no automatically scaled allowances or thresholds raised merely to pass. Independent browser commands should remain usable while full profile fails.

suggestedCheckpoints.A: Record supported-command matrix and exact baseline failures; repair compiler profiles with focused types, save draft before broad build orchestration.
suggestedCheckpoints.B: Add named package/Taskfile wrappers, fresh sequential smoke prerequisites and complete discovery coverage; validate smoke failure paths and all supported types locally.
suggestedCheckpoints.C: Run fresh builds, existing unit/catalog/tooling/semantic/consumer checks and four profile discovery/type checks; save exact source/evidence. Chromium/manual and artifact-policy acceptance remain explicitly open for final Mac pass.

limitations: No browser execution, actual host, hosted CI or artifact budget approval.
No root-license adoption, package/dependency upgrade or private-source inspection.
Static configuration inspection cannot prove cause of historical sitemap collision.

workspaceAndStoryBaseline.scope: Read-only compiler baseline; no application build, browser execution or repository edits. Composite configs may create ignored incremental compiler metadata.
workspaceAndStoryBaseline.remainingFailures: Earlier tooling58/Vitest27 diagnostics at PR105 baseline remain open until fresh52 repair verification; these new checks do not replace them.

proposedScripts.typecheck: Keep existing fast public site/catalog/domain command.
proposedScripts.typecheck:all: pnpm typecheck && pnpm typecheck:locales && pnpm typecheck:tooling && pnpm typecheck:tests && pnpm typecheck:browser && pnpm typecheck:stories && pnpm typecheck:workspaces

tsconfig.node.json.modulePolicy: Inherit Preserve/Bundler for Vite/Storybook/tool configuration; no root package type change and no declaration-emitting composite graph.
tsconfig.node.json.excludeNote: Browser-side Storybook manager/preview/theme remain checked by three existing story profiles; choose actual environment libs based on strict compiler results.

tsconfig.vitest.json.aliases: Map #test-utils and explicitly used workspace source aliases consistent with runtime Vitest config.
tsconfig.vitest.json.types: Retain strict ES2022/DOM/Vite/Node with no compiler weakening; replace test-only toReversed with copying reverse or justify node test lib separately.

tsconfig.store-browser.json.scope: All maintained browser runner configs, specs and browser fixtures. Node .mts journey harnesses stay covered by tsconfig.store; preserve independent DOM-free domain profile.
